# hoop_ai_session_analyzer_rule (Resource)

Manages an AI session analyzer rule. On the gateway the rule classifies the sessions of `connection_names` and applies `risk_evaluation`. On a sidecar fleet, `sidecar_spec` is the analyzer block a listener receives and `sidecar_targets` names the listeners; one rule per listener.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Session analysis on the gateway for two connections.
resource "hoop_ai_session_analyzer_rule" "prod" {
  name             = "prod-analysis"
  description      = "Block high-risk sessions on production databases"
  connection_names = [hoop_connection.pg_prod.name, hoop_connection.mysql_prod.name]

  risk_evaluation = {
    low_risk    = { action = "allow_execution" }
    medium_risk = { action = "allow_execution" }
    high_risk   = { action = "require_access_request", access_request_rule_name = "prod-approvals" }
  }

  custom_prompt = "Treat any query that touches the payments schema as high risk."
}

# Statement analysis on a sidecar listener. sidecar_spec is the analyzer block
# the listener receives; a held statement waits up to 15 minutes for one of
# the dba-leads to release it.
resource "hoop_ai_session_analyzer_rule" "appdb" {
  name = "appdb-analysis"

  risk_evaluation = {
    low_risk    = { action = "allow_execution" }
    medium_risk = { action = "allow_execution" }
    high_risk   = { action = "block_execution" }
  }

  sidecar_spec = jsonencode({
    trigger = "statement"
    high    = "defer"
  })

  sidecar_targets  = [{ sidecar_id = hoop_sidecar.payments.id, listener_name = "appdb" }]
  reviewers_groups = ["dba-leads"]
  pending_ttl_sec  = 900
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name of the rule. The gateway addresses the rule by it, so a change replaces the rule.
- `risk_evaluation` (Attributes) The action for each risk level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_evaluation))

### Optional

- `agentic` (Boolean) When true the analyzer runs a tool-calling loop over past sessions and resource metadata before classifying.
- `approval_ttl_sec` (Number) Seconds an approval lasts, 60 to 604800. Same conditions as `pending_ttl_sec`.
- `connection_names` (List of String) The connections this rule analyzes on the gateway. Leave it out for a rule that only sidecars run.
- `custom_prompt` (String) Extra instructions appended to the default system prompt.
- `description` (String) The rule description.
- `pending_ttl_sec` (Number) Seconds a held statement's review may wait for a decision, 60 to 604800. The gateway reads it only while `sidecar_spec` holds statements for approval.
- `reviewers_groups` (List of String) The groups whose members may release a statement this rule holds for approval. With none set the admin group reviews. Leave the attribute out to keep groups set outside Terraform; removing a declared value clears them.
- `sidecar_spec` (String) The rule in the sidecar's own vocabulary, as a JSON object. The control plane places this block on each bound listener. Leave the attribute out to keep the block stored on the gateway; removing a declared value clears it.
- `sidecar_targets` (Attributes List) The sidecar listeners the control plane distributes this rule to. Each entry names a sidecar and one of its listeners, or the whole sidecar when `listener_name` is empty. Leave the attribute out to keep bindings made outside Terraform. Set it to `[]` to unbind the rule from every sidecar. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sidecar_targets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--risk_evaluation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risk_evaluation`

Required:

- `high_risk` (Attributes) What the analyzer does with a session it classifies as high risk. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_evaluation--high_risk))
- `low_risk` (Attributes) What the analyzer does with a session it classifies as low risk. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_evaluation--low_risk))
- `medium_risk` (Attributes) What the analyzer does with a session it classifies as medium risk. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_evaluation--medium_risk))

<a id="nestedatt--risk_evaluation--high_risk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risk_evaluation.high_risk`

Required:

- `action` (String) One of `allow_execution`, `block_execution` or `require_access_request`.

Optional:

- `access_request_rule_name` (String) The access request rule that supplies the approver groups when the action is `require_access_request`.


<a id="nestedatt--risk_evaluation--low_risk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risk_evaluation.low_risk`

Required:

- `action` (String) One of `allow_execution`, `block_execution` or `require_access_request`.

Optional:

- `access_request_rule_name` (String) The access request rule that supplies the approver groups when the action is `require_access_request`.


<a id="nestedatt--risk_evaluation--medium_risk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risk_evaluation.medium_risk`

Required:

- `action` (String) One of `allow_execution`, `block_execution` or `require_access_request`.

Optional:

- `access_request_rule_name` (String) The access request rule that supplies the approver groups when the action is `require_access_request`.



<a id="nestedatt--sidecar_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sidecar_targets`

Required:

- `sidecar_id` (String) The sidecar that enforces the rule.

Optional:

- `listener_name` (String) The listener on that sidecar. Empty binds every listener the sidecar has.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# The gateway addresses the rule by name.
terraform import hoop_ai_session_analyzer_rule.prod prod-analysis
```
